name: Dialog mugshots
author: PokePat
description: Shows a 64×64 picture of the person who speaks next to the message box – on the right, or on the left (mirrored, so the person looks at the text). A script chooses it with ShowMugshot MUGSHOT_X (or ShowMugshot MUGSHOT_X, MUGSHOT_POS_LEFT) before Message; it disappears with ClearMugshot or when the message box closes. Bigger pictures (e.g. a treasure map, up to 192 tiles such as 128×96) are shown in the middle with ShowPicture PICTURE_X and hidden with HidePicture or CloseMessage. Full-screen pictures (256×192, up to 255 colours) get a screen of their own like the Town Map: ShowFullscreenPicture FULLSCREEN_X fades out, shows the picture until A or B is pressed and comes back. Mugshots and pictures are managed in PokePat (Mugshots module, after switching the mod on). Uses new script commands – the commands of the original game stay untouched.

edits.text:
# PokePat mod platinum-mugshots: dialog pictures, stored after the map popups.
subdir('mugshots')

mugshot_ncgrs = ncgr_gen.process(
    mugshot_files,
    extra_args: [
        '-version101',
        '-sopc',
        '-convertTo4Bpp',
        '-width', '8',
    ]
)

mugshot_nclrs = nclr_gen.process(
    mugshot_files,
    extra_args: [
        '-bitdepth', '4'
    ]
)

fullscreen_ncgrs = ncgr_gen.process(
    fullscreen_files,
    extra_args: [
        '-version101',
        '-sopc',
        '-bitdepth', '8',
    ]
)

fullscreen_nclrs = nclr_gen.process(
    fullscreen_files,
    extra_args: [
        '-bitdepth', '8'
    ]
)

ScriptCommand(SCRCMD_SHOWMUGSHOT,                                          ScrCmd_ShowMugshot)
ScriptCommand(SCRCMD_CLEARMUGSHOT,                                         ScrCmd_ClearMugshot)
ScriptCommand(SCRCMD_SHOWPICTURE,                                          ScrCmd_ShowPicture)
ScriptCommand(SCRCMD_HIDEPICTURE,                                          ScrCmd_HidePicture)
ScriptCommand(SCRCMD_SHOWFULLSCREENPICTURE,                                ScrCmd_ShowFullscreenPicture)

@ PokePat mod platinum-mugshots
    .macro ShowMugshot mugshot, side=0
    .short SCRCMD_SHOWMUGSHOT
    .short \mugshot
    .short \side
    .endm

    .macro ClearMugshot
    .short SCRCMD_CLEARMUGSHOT
    .endm

    .macro ShowPicture picture
    .short SCRCMD_SHOWPICTURE
    .short \picture
    .endm

    .macro HidePicture
    .short SCRCMD_HIDEPICTURE
    .endm

    .macro ShowFullscreenPicture picture
    FadeScreenOut
    WaitFadeScreen
    .short SCRCMD_SHOWFULLSCREENPICTURE
    .short \picture
    ReturnToField
    FadeScreenIn
    WaitFadeScreen
    .endm

edits.anchor:
ScriptMessage_Show(ctx, ctx->loader, messageID, TRUE, NULL);
    ScriptContext_Pause(ctx, ScriptContext_WaitForFinishedPrinting);

usage:
In a script: #include "constants/mugshots.h" at the top, then
    ShowMugshot MUGSHOT_EXAMPLE                     (right of the box)
    ShowMugshot MUGSHOT_EXAMPLE, MUGSHOT_POS_LEFT   (left, mirrored)
    Message 0
    WaitButton
    CloseMessage
The mugshot stays for all messages until the box closes (CloseMessage) or ClearMugshot.
A picture: ShowPicture PICTURE_TREASURE_MAP … HidePicture (or CloseMessage).
A full-screen picture (after CloseMessage): ShowFullscreenPicture FULLSCREEN_EXAMPLE – A or B closes it.
In PokePat: Mugshots module (add mugshots and pictures), Events & Dialogs → blocks "Mugshot" and "Picture".
